name: list_changes
title: List what changed on an API
description: What was done to an API in the control plane: deployments, starts and stops, and its audit trail (plans, subscriptions, API keys, members, definition), each with the user who did it, newest first. Compare the timestamps with when the traffic moved: a change just before is the first thing to look at.

environment.description: Id, HRID or name of an environment. Omit when you can read only one. Call list_environments to see them. Omit when `api` names an API that exists in only one environment you can read.

api.description: Id or name of the API.

window.description: Length of the time range to look at, ending at `until`: a number followed by m, h or d, for example 15m, 2h or 1d. Default 1h. Never an epoch value.

until.description: End of the time range as an ISO-8601 UTC instant, for example 2026-01-31T14:00:00Z. Default: now.

event.description: For example PUBLISH_API, PLAN_UPDATED, SUBSCRIPTION_CLOSED, APIKEY_REVOKED.

details.description: What the change applies to, by type: PLAN, APPLICATION, API_KEY (the key id, never its value).

omittedSources.description: Sources you are not allowed to read. When not empty, an empty `changes` does not mean nothing changed.
